findings.title: CTF Flag Extracted via LFI + Unrestricted File Upload (RCE)
findings.description: The application has a Local File Inclusion vulnerability in post.php (id parameter). The LFI protection blocks path traversal using '..' but allows subdirectory references without dots. Combined with an unrestricted file upload endpoint at /posts/upload-article.php that saves PHP files to /posts/uploads/ (static-served but LFI-executable), a webshell can be uploaded and then included via LFI to achieve Remote Code Execution. This was used to read /FLAG.txt and extract the CTF flag.

diagrams.title: Encoder64 Blog Attack Surface

flowchart TD

  Attacker --> UploadPHP["posts/upload-article.php (File Upload)"]
  PostPHP --> PostsDir["posts/ directory (PHP includes)"]
  PostsDir --> UploadsDir["posts/uploads/ (uploaded files - static served)"]
  UploadPHP --> UploadsDir
  PostPHP -- "id=uploads/webshell&cmd=" --> UploadsDir
  UploadsDir -- "PHP execute via include()" --> RCE["RCE as www-data"]
  RCE --> FlagFile["/FLAG.txt - flag found"]
